<script module>export const _flow = { sourceVersion: 2, page: { id: "mine", route: "/mine", title: "Mes équipements" } };</script>
<FlowComponent $$id="mine">
  <Variables>
    <State $$id="session" type="object" value={{ authenticated: false, admin: false }} />
    <State $$id="ready" type="boolean" value={false} />
    <State $$id="row" type="object" value={null} />
    <State $$id="showForm" type="boolean" value={false} />
    <State $$id="refreshKey" type="number" value={0} />
    <State $$id="notice" type="string" value="" />
  </Variables>
  <Events><OnMount $$id="checkSession"><Actions>
    <CallSequence $$id="current" requestable=".CurrentSession" $$out="page.session" />
    <If $$id="allowed" test="@page.session.authenticated"><Then><SetValue $$id="readyNow" target="page.ready" value={true} /></Then><Else><Navigate $$id="goHome" page="home" /></Else></If>
  </Actions></OnMount></Events>
  <Structure><PageShell $$id="shell"><Children>
    <PageHeader $$id="header" title="Mes équipements" />
    <If $$id="guard" test="@page.ready"><Then>
      
      <Text $$id="noticeText" text="@page.notice" />
      <EntityTable $$id="table" entity="Equipement" ownershipFilter="mine" refreshKey="@page.refreshKey">
        <Toolbar><If $$id="createAllowed" test={context.permissions.create}><Then><Button $$id="create" label="Nouvel équipement"><Events><OnClick $$id="newEquipment"><Actions>
        <SetValue $$id="clearNewRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="openNew" target="page.showForm" value={true} />
      </Actions></OnClick></Events></Button></Then></If></Toolbar>
        <Empty><Text $$id="empty" text="Aucun équipement" /></Empty>
        <Cell><Text $$id="cellValue" text={row.labels?.[field.name] || row.values[field.name]} /></Cell>
        <Events><OnSelect $$id="selectEquipment"><Actions>
          <SetValue $$id="selectedRow" target="page.row" value="@event.value" /><SetValue $$id="openSelected" target="page.showForm" value={true} />
        </Actions></OnSelect></Events>
      </EntityTable>
      <If $$id="editing" test="@page.showForm"><Then>
        <EntityForm $$id="form" entity="Equipement" row="@page.row">
          <Actions><Text $$id="hint" text="Les droits sont contrôlés par le serveur" /></Actions>
          <Events>
            <OnCancel $$id="cancelEdit"><Actions><SetValue $$id="closeEditor" target="page.showForm" value={false} /><SetValue $$id="clearClosedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /></Actions></OnCancel>
            <OnSaved $$id="saved"><Actions>
              <SetValue $$id="clearSavedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="closeSaved" target="page.showForm" value={false} />
              <UpdateNumber $$id="refreshSaved" target="page.refreshKey" operation="increment" step={1} /><SetValue $$id="savedNotice" target="page.notice" value="Enregistré" />
            </Actions></OnSaved>
            <OnDeleted $$id="deleted"><Actions>
              <SetValue $$id="clearDeletedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="closeDeleted" target="page.showForm" value={false} />
              <UpdateNumber $$id="refreshDeleted" target="page.refreshKey" operation="increment" step={1} /><SetValue $$id="deletedNotice" target="page.notice" value="Supprimé" />
            </Actions></OnDeleted>
          </Events>
        </EntityForm>
      </Then></If>
    </Then></If>
  </Children></PageShell></Structure>
</FlowComponent>

<script module>export const _flow = { sourceVersion: 2, page: { id: "admin", route: "/admin", title: "Administration" } };</script>
<FlowComponent $$id="admin">
  <Variables>
    <State $$id="session" type="object" value={{ authenticated: false, admin: false }} />
    <State $$id="ready" type="boolean" value={false} />
    <State $$id="row" type="object" value={null} />
    <State $$id="showForm" type="boolean" value={false} />
    <State $$id="refreshKey" type="number" value={0} />
    <State $$id="notice" type="string" value="" />
    <State $$id="operationRow" type="object" value={null} />
    <State $$id="showOperationForm" type="boolean" value={false} />
    <State $$id="operationRefresh" type="number" value={0} />
  </Variables>
  <Events><OnMount $$id="checkSession"><Actions>
    <CallSequence $$id="current" requestable=".CurrentSession" $$out="page.session" />
    <If $$id="allowed" test="@page.session.admin"><Then><SetValue $$id="readyNow" target="page.ready" value={true} /></Then><Else><If $$id="signedIn" test="@page.session.authenticated"><Then><Navigate $$id="goMine" page="mine" /></Then><Else><Navigate $$id="goHome" page="home" /></Else></If></Else></If>
  </Actions></OnMount></Events>
  <Structure><PageShell $$id="shell"><Children>
    <PageHeader $$id="header" title="Administration" />
    <If $$id="guard" test="@page.ready"><Then>
      
      <Text $$id="noticeText" text="@page.notice" />
      <EntityTable $$id="table" entity="Equipement" ownershipFilter="all" refreshKey="@page.refreshKey">
        <Toolbar><If $$id="createAllowed" test={context.permissions.create}><Then><Button $$id="create" label="Nouvel équipement"><Events><OnClick $$id="newEquipment"><Actions>
        <SetValue $$id="clearNewRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="openNew" target="page.showForm" value={true} />
      </Actions></OnClick></Events></Button></Then></If></Toolbar>
        <Empty><Text $$id="empty" text="Aucun équipement" /></Empty>
        <Cell><Text $$id="cellValue" text={row.labels?.[field.name] || row.values[field.name]} /></Cell>
        <Events><OnSelect $$id="selectEquipment"><Actions>
          <SetValue $$id="selectedRow" target="page.row" value="@event.value" /><SetValue $$id="openSelected" target="page.showForm" value={true} />
        </Actions></OnSelect></Events>
      </EntityTable>
      <If $$id="editing" test="@page.showForm"><Then>
        <EntityForm $$id="form" entity="Equipement" row="@page.row">
          <Actions><Text $$id="hint" text="Les droits sont contrôlés par le serveur" /></Actions>
          <Events>
            <OnCancel $$id="cancelEdit"><Actions><SetValue $$id="closeEditor" target="page.showForm" value={false} /><SetValue $$id="clearClosedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /></Actions></OnCancel>
            <OnSaved $$id="saved"><Actions>
              <SetValue $$id="clearSavedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="closeSaved" target="page.showForm" value={false} />
              <UpdateNumber $$id="refreshSaved" target="page.refreshKey" operation="increment" step={1} /><SetValue $$id="savedNotice" target="page.notice" value="Enregistré" />
            </Actions></OnSaved>
            <OnDeleted $$id="deleted"><Actions>
              <SetValue $$id="clearDeletedRow" target="page.row" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="closeDeleted" target="page.showForm" value={false} />
              <UpdateNumber $$id="refreshDeleted" target="page.refreshKey" operation="increment" step={1} /><SetValue $$id="deletedNotice" target="page.notice" value="Supprimé" />
            </Actions></OnDeleted>
          </Events>
        </EntityForm>
      </Then></If>
      <PageHeader $$id="operationHeader" title="Registre immuable" />
      <Button $$id="newOperation" label="Nouvelle opération"><Events><OnClick $$id="createOperation"><Actions>
        <SetValue $$id="clearOperation" target="page.operationRow" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="showNewOperation" target="page.showOperationForm" value={true} />
      </Actions></OnClick></Events></Button>
      <EntityTable $$id="operationTable" entity="Operation" refreshKey="@page.operationRefresh">
        <Events><OnSelect $$id="selectOperation"><Actions><SetValue $$id="keepOperation" target="page.operationRow" value="@event.value" /><SetValue $$id="openOperation" target="page.showOperationForm" value={true} /></Actions></OnSelect></Events>
      </EntityTable>
      <If $$id="operationEditor" test="@page.showOperationForm"><Then><EntityForm $$id="operationForm" entity="Operation" row="@page.operationRow">
        <Events><OnCancel $$id="cancelOperation"><Actions><SetValue $$id="closeOperationView" target="page.showOperationForm" value={false} /><SetValue $$id="clearClosedOperation" target="page.operationRow" value={null} /></Actions></OnCancel><OnSaved $$id="operationSaved"><Actions>
          <SetValue $$id="clearSavedOperation" target="page.operationRow" value={null} /><SetValue $$id="closeOperation" target="page.showOperationForm" value={false} />
          <UpdateNumber $$id="refreshOperation" target="page.operationRefresh" operation="increment" step={1} />
        </Actions></OnSaved></Events>
      </EntityForm></Then></If>
    </Then></If>
  </Children></PageShell></Structure>
</FlowComponent>

<script module>export const _flow = { sourceVersion: 2, app: { id: "${PROJECT}", title: "Équipements", locale: "fr-FR" }, page: { id: "home", route: "/", title: "Connexion" } };</script>
<FlowComponent $$id="home"><Variables><State $$id="email" type="string" value=""/><State $$id="password" type="string" value=""/><State $$id="login" type="object" value={{}}/></Variables><Structure><PageShell $$id="shell"><Children><PageHeader $$id="header" title="Équipements"/><Form $$id="signIn"><Children><Input $$id="emailInput" label="Email" value="@page.email"><Events><OnInput $$id="emailTyped"><Actions><SetValue $$id="setEmail" target="page.email" value="@event.value"/></Actions></OnInput></Events></Input><Input $$id="passwordInput" label="Mot de passe" type="password" value="@page.password"><Events><OnInput $$id="passwordTyped"><Actions><SetValue $$id="setPassword" target="page.password" value="@event.value"/></Actions></OnInput></Events></Input><Button $$id="submit" label="Connexion" type="submit"/></Children><Events><OnSubmit $$id="submitLogin"><Actions><CallSequence $$id="signInCall" requestable="${PROJECT}.SignIn" $$out="page.login"><Variables><Variable name="user" value="@page.email"/><Variable name="password" value="@page.password"/></Variables></CallSequence><If $$id="authenticated" test="@page.login.user"><Then><SetValue $$id="clearPassword" target="page.password" value=""/><If $$id="adminLanding" test="@page.login.admin"><Then><Navigate $$id="openAdmin" page="admin"/></Then><Else><Navigate $$id="openMine" page="mine"/></Else></If></Then></If></Actions></OnSubmit></Events></Form><Status $$id="loginStatus" actionId="signInCall" /><Text $$id="loginError" text={page.login.error?.message || ""} /></Children></PageShell></Structure></FlowComponent>

<script module>export const _flow = { sourceVersion: 2 };</script>
<FlowComponent $$id="appLayout">
  <Variables><State $$id="session" type="object" value={{ authenticated: false, user: null, admin: false }} /></Variables>
  <Events><OnAfterNavigate $$id="refreshSession"><Actions><CallSequence $$id="currentSession" requestable=".CurrentSession" $$out="layout.session" /></Actions></OnAfterNavigate></Events>
  <Structure><AppShell $$id="appShell" title="Équipements" userName={layout.session.user || ""}>
    <Navigation>
      <LinkButton $$id="homeLink" label="Connexion" page="home" />
      <If $$id="signedIn" test="@layout.session.authenticated"><Then><LinkButton $$id="mineLink" label="Mes équipements" page="mine" /></Then></If>
      <If $$id="adminOnly" test="@layout.session.admin"><Then><LinkButton $$id="adminLink" label="Administration" page="admin" /></Then></If>
    </Navigation>
    <Tools><If $$id="canSignOut" test="@layout.session.authenticated"><Then><Button $$id="logout" label="Déconnexion"><Events><OnClick $$id="logoutClicked"><Actions>
      <CallSequence $$id="signOut" requestable=".SignOut"><Variables><Variable name="__disableAutologin" value={true} /></Variables></CallSequence>
      <SetValue $$id="clearSession" target="layout.session" value={{ authenticated: false, user: null, admin: false }} /><Navigate $$id="backHome" page="home" />
    </Actions></OnClick></Events></Button></Then></If></Tools>
    <Children><PageContent $$id="pageContent" /></Children>
  </AppShell></Structure>
</FlowComponent>

limits: MCP bearer authoring and application accounts are separate identities. Deployment initializes via a real application ADMIN session; no actor impersonation.
Model/authentication storage, SQL migration and UI interaction are qualified by separate runtime/browser proofs, not by a successful model write.
